name: Cellular Cosmos
author: Motif
description: Translucent emerald membranes, coral colonies, radial organs and dark channels. A deterministic periodic lifecycle of division, migration and reintegration. Nine seamless infinite loops.

styles.name: Cellular Cosmos Hero
styles.blurb: Emerald and coral colonies with radial organs; daughters divide, wander and rejoin on one closed cycle.

count.label: Colony count
count.hint: Approximate number of colonies in the frame. Sets the cell size.

species.label: Species mix
species.hint: Share of coral colonies against emerald cells.

membrane.label: Membrane width
membrane.hint: Width of the bright membrane and its dark channel, scene units.

translucency.label: Translucency
translucency.hint: How glassy the cell bodies are.

organelles.label: Organelle density
organelles.hint: Number of organelle points circling each nucleus.

filaments.label: Filament count
filaments.hint: Radial filaments around each nucleus. A spatial count.

divAmp.label: Division amplitude
divAmp.hint: How far a daughter cell separates from its parent.

migrate.label: Migration radius
migrate.hint: Radius of each colony's closed migration orbit.

cycles.label: Lifecycles per loop
cycles.hint: Whole division and reintegration cycles per loop.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Linear exposure before the single tone map.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.hint: Glow added around emissive light. 0 shows the bare geometry.

bloomRadius.label: Bloom radius
bloomRadius.hint: Width of the glow relative to the frame.

lensCA.label: Edge fringe
lensCA.hint: Spectral fringing toward the frame edge.

vignette.label: Vignette
vignette.hint: Darkens the frame edge; never touches the focal area.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: Sample counts only. Composition, phase and exposure stay the same.
